metadata.title: Stanley Druckenmiller dumped these chip stocks while buying into SpaceX and Palantir - MarketWatch

content.text:
Tech Stocks
Stanley Druckenmiller dumped these chip stocks while buying into SpaceX and Palantir
Druckenmiller’s family office unloaded AMD and Sandisk shares in the third quarter
It’s been a bruising autumn for many buzzy technology stocks, and a new filing indicates how investor Stanley Druckenmiller positioned his portfolio leading into the heart of the fall.
Druckenmiller’s Duquesne Family Office exited positions in Advanced Micro Devices AMD and Sandisk SNDK in the September quarter, according to the firm’s latest 13F filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission. The filing doesn’t detail the precise points that the sales of those semiconductor stocks were made during that quarter.
